note: Proposed (not-shipped) contract shape per docs/design/design-pipeline.md §2 S2 and the design-architecture-partition skill. No klt verb emits this. Strategy (how to trade power/area) is out of scope for the skill; only the closed partition is recorded here.

blocks.name: bias_gen
blocks.function: Generate the OTA tail bias current (nominal 20 uA reference) from the supply.
blocks.note: A beta-multiplier / current-mirror bias cell (see kb entry beta-multiplier-bias-cell) would fill this role; NOT driven through the pipeline in this worked example (scope: one block).

blocks.name: ota_buffer
blocks.function: Single-stage OTA used in unity-gain feedback to buffer the reference node onto the 1 pF SC load.

supply_current_ua.note: includes the tail branch plus the on-block bias-mirror replica branch fed by ibias_in

partition_closure.closure_note: First-pass allocation (25 + 60 = 85 uA) slightly overshoots the 150 uW / 83.3 uA-at-1.8V system budget. It closes at the nominal 1.8 V worst-case-current interpretation only if the two blocks do not simultaneously hit their individual ceilings; the OTA measured worst case (S10) lands well under its 60 uA ceiling, so the realized partition closes. Recorded honestly rather than back-fitting the ceilings to force closure -- this is the S2 'partition that doesn't close' failure mode the skill names, surfaced and resolved by the S10 measurement rather than hidden.
